description: Live E2E for the Terrain3D RQL module (wraps the Terrain3D GDExtension addon, installed into the test project from extension.json testAddon before --import). Driven by scripts/extension_e2e.py (via scripts/extension_live.py) against ONE connected headless editor and a local gamedev-mcp-server. The module ships no MCP tools: every call is the core rql-query / rql-mutate / rql-schema, and a regression in the module (sources, function, ChangeRegionSize validation, guide) turns the suite red.
notes: The 'setup' opens a fresh scene (root Node3D 'Root') with the core editor | call NewScene. rql-schema "terrain3d" proves the module was discovered (its view type). The 'tools' then run every Terrain3DGuide example in order (the xUnit suite asserts this list contains them all, in order, each with rql-mutate for set / call and rql-query otherwise), followed by read-backs and a rejected region size. 'expect' substrings are matched against the default compact RQL text inside godot-cli's --raw JSON: rows are '|'-separated. A Terrain3D node's C# type is Node3D, so refs read Node3D#…(Terrain).

input.query: terrain3d | select name regionSize dataDirectory meshLods meshSize vertexSpacing version
terrain3d | where name == "Terrain" | get node | set props["data_directory"] = "res://terrain_data"
terrain3d | where name == "Terrain" | get node | set props["material"] = terrain3d.newMaterial()
terrain3d | where name == "Terrain" | get node | set props["mesh_lods"] = 8, props["vertex_spacing"] = 2
terrain3d | select name regionSize dataDirectory material.class regionCount meshLods vertexSpacing
nodes | where class == "Terrain3D" | select name props["region_size"] props["data_directory"]
